usedFor: Elastic Email holds mailing lists and campaigns, and HubSpot receives people through “Create Contact” and “Create Deal”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new contact is added to a specified contact list” in Elastic Email, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new list member becomes a HubSpot contact, and the action returns the created record.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, and “When a contact unsubscribes” in Elastic Email is polling.
